Question Choices: You have 24 apples and 36 oranges. You want to make identical groups, each with the same number of apples and the same number of oranges, with no leftovers. What is the largest number of groups you can make?
Hints: List common positive factors; choose the greatest one.
Solution: Factors of 24: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24; Factors of 36: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36. Common factors: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12. The greatest is 12. Make 12 identical groups, each with 2 of the first item and 3 of the second item. Check: 12×2=24 and 12×3=36.
